messages.subject: Project Ironvale - Legal DD Report
messages.plaintextBody:
Margaret, Daniel, Priya,

Our legal due diligence report is attached. Headlines: no fundamental impediments. Key red flag is the Hollencroft change-of-control right (c.18% of revenue) - we recommend proceeding on a Buyer-waiver basis covered by the W&I policy rather than making it a condition. Other items (THERMACORE EU opposition, open R&D enquiry, environmental permit) are low risk and covered by the warranty/indemnity package.

Happy to walk through on a call.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
